decisions.reason: As a 2023 flagship close to the core dosimetry business and still promoted on the home page in 2024, it looks strategically important and cheap to keep while upside continues to unfold.
This oncology risk-management software extends the firm's established QA workflow capabilities, and with only two years of market evidence there is still option value in keeping it available.
The CT image quality phantom fits the firm's medical imaging QA direction, and because it was only launched in 2024 the uncertainty has not resolved enough to justify abandonment.
The mammography image quality phantom is more distant from the core offer, but as a very recent launch in an expanding firm it remains a worthwhile exploratory option for now.

This full field mammography test phantom is also peripheral and recently introduced, so it carries a higher pruning risk, yet the firm is still likely to keep the option open another year before concluding on its value.
A flagship 2024 product line that builds on the established imaging QA business is highly aligned with the firm's stated direction, so continued market presence is the most likely choice.
